title: Fourteen Summers and One Short Wake
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：dolphin　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 dolphin 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 my grandfather ① followed a dolphin that no fisherman in the bay would have named, and he said the following was the whole of the summer. The ② dolphin, meaning the animal and not the figure, swam fourteen summers and stayed unnamed in the book; a dolphin, he said, is the only thing in a bay that is judged by how long it is left unled.

Every ③ dolphin in that bay had the same short wake behind the boat of it, and the ④ dolphin at the end, meaning the one they kept to lead the boats and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A dolphin, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to follow; my grandfather said the following is the part that fills fourteen summers.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the dolphin was the whole of the story, meaning the figure and not the animal. The ⑥ dolphin, meaning the figure and not any of that, is the only thing in a story that everybody follows and nobody thanks; dolphin, he said, is either something you follow or the only word that means both an animal and a figure. He said the figure is the part they remember.

By 1970 the ⑦ dolphin had become a line in a record, and the record had become an argument about the short wake. The ⑧ dolphin of the whole thing, my grandfather wrote in July, was one bay and fourteen summers of following; dolphin, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to follow. She said the following was never mentioned.

The ⑨ dolphin I remember is the one named in the record, which left in 1982 and is still described as the quietest in the bay. A ⑩ dolphin, my grandmother said in 1984, is the only one who improves by being followed; every dolphin, she said, is a figure that has agreed to look like an animal. She said the figure was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 海豚（指那片海湾里游着的那一只）
B. n. 海豚（指那只动物本身，与那个身影相对）
C. 固定搭配：follow a dolphin 跟随一只海豚
D. n. 海豚（指留给渔船带路的那一只）
E. n. 海豚（抽象总称，指一片海湾的观豚之事）
F. n. 海豚（指记录簿上写到、被列名的那一只）
G. n. 给人带路的人；引路者（指故事里人人跟随却无人致谢的那个人）
H. n. 引路者（抽象总称，指人人跟随却无人致谢的那种人）

answers.why: follow a dolphin 意为“跟随一只海豚”，1961 年祖父跟随了一只海湾里没有一位渔夫肯叫出名字的海豚。
dolphin 意为“海豚”，指那只动物本身而不是那个身影，它游了十四个夏天而在簿子上没有名字。
dolphin 意为“海豚”，指那片海湾里的每一只海豚，每一只船尾后面都有同一道短短的水痕。
dolphin 意为“海豚”，指留给渔船带路的那一只，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
dolphin 意为“给人带路的人、引路者”，指故事里人人跟随却无人致谢的那个人，叔叔说这个引路者就是那个故事的全部。
dolphin 意为“引路者”，指人人跟随却无人致谢的那种人而不是那只动物，是故事里人人都跟、却无人致谢的东西。
dolphin 意为“海豚”，指记录簿上写到、被列名的那一只，到 1970 年这只海豚成了记录簿里的一行。
dolphin 意为“海豚”，祖父七月写道，整件事的观豚之事是一片海湾和十四个夏天的跟随。
dolphin 意为“海豚”，我记得的是记录簿上列名的那一只，1982 年离开了，至今仍被说成海湾里最安静的一只。
dolphin 为抽象总称，祖母 1984 年说，一只海豚是唯一会因为被好好跟随而变得更好的生灵。

items: 1961 年祖父跟随了一只海湾里没有一位渔夫肯叫出名字的海豚，他说跟着才是那个夏天的全部。（follow a dolphin）
